nodes.label: currentsong.txt
nodes.rationale: moOde-written metadata file at /var/local/www/currentsong.txt; the scrobbler's sole input. Must be enabled in moOde MPD options or the scrobbler sees nothing.

nodes.label: Canonical Scrobble Rule
nodes.rationale: min(duration * 50%, 240s) with floor at min_play_time, per ListenBrainz/MetaBrainz recommendations. Falls back to min_play_time when duration is absent from currentsong.txt (streams filtered via patterns).

nodes.label: min_play_time Floor
nodes.rationale: Configurable floor (default 30s) under the canonical rule; also the always-used fallback delay for renderer sessions that carry no duration.

nodes.label: Offline Cache
nodes.rationale: Survive network outages: individual submission for <3 pending, batch up to 10 after recovery, 60s connection re-check, atomic writes (fsync + rename), .corrupt.<timestamp> backup on parse errors.

nodes.label: Pattern Filters
nodes.rationale: Skip scrobbles matching artist/album/title patterns (radio streams, unknown artists); case sensitivity configurable.

nodes.label: Token Storage (.env)
nodes.rationale: ListenBrainz token lives in .env (mode 600, gitignored), never in settings.json; redacted in all log output.

nodes.label: lbms.service Systemd Unit
nodes.rationale: Installed to /etc/systemd/system/lbms.service by install.sh; enabled for boot autostart; runs as $SUDO_USER (fallback pi); waits for network-online.target.

nodes.label: AirPlay / Spotify Connect Renderers
nodes.rationale: moOde 10.2+ writes renderer artist/album/title with no state or duration, so pause is not detectable and the scrobble delay is always the min_play_time fallback. Bluetooth, Squeezelite, RoonBridge, Deezer are out of scope (marker only, no metadata).

nodes.label: Repeat-1 Single Listen Limitation
nodes.rationale: Repeating the same track without a state transition produces a single listen: track identity is title/artist/album and MPD does not signal the boundary in currentsong.txt.

nodes.label: Pause/Resume Duplicate Fix (1.2.2)
nodes.rationale: Pause no longer discards track state; resume re-arms the listen timer only if the play session has not scrobbled yet; listened_at reports play start time instead of submission time.

nodes.label: Atomic Cache Write Durability
nodes.rationale: 1.2.0 closed a durability gap: fsync on file and parent dir; corrupted cache backed up as .corrupt.<ts> instead of silently destroyed.

nodes.label: Song Identity by Title/Artist/Album
nodes.rationale: 1.1.0: comparison uses only title/artist/album to prevent duplicate scrobbles when currentsong.txt rewrites with unchanged track.
